challenge.method: Extract the passage from the 2007 attribution through the final disclaimer from COPYING, standalone SPDX text, and decoded JSON licenseText. Lowercase and tokenize maximal ASCII letter-or-digit runs. Compare every token position, repeat with letters only, test title inclusion, compare the full SPDX values, and match the annotated tag target to both pinned URLs.
challenge.results: All three bounded sequences contain 449 tokens in identical order. A letters-only tokenizer gives 440 in each because it drops 2007 and the eight condition numbers. Including the title gives 455 tokens in each. COPYING adds title indentation and a dashed rule and uses different wrapping and spacing. Both complete SPDX text values are identical, and both pinned URLs match the annotated commit target.

limitations: The 449 count depends on including digits in the tokenization. The title and COPYING separator are outside the bounded passage.
The SPDX representations share a source revision. The annotated tag is unsigned.
The result applies to the captured LFT 3.91-2 notice and the two pinned SPDX artifacts. Later notices and legal effect require separate evidence.
reasoning: The three artifacts agree at every token position under the stated rule, and the annotated SPDX tag targets the exact revision of both SPDX representations.
